certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Official North Carolina State Board of Elections static ENR data files for the 2024 General Election. The local archive contains county.txt, contest.txt, results_0.txt, and results_1.txt through results_100.txt from the 20241105 data path.

turnout.sourceTitle: 2024 General Election Turnout history_stats and voter_stats
turnout.sourceAuthority: North Carolina State Board of Elections
turnout.notes: Official NCSBE history_stats rows are joined to voter_stats denominators by county, precinct, and VTD. Denominators are warning-labeled because voter_stats is a Nov. 5, 2024 registration snapshot; turnout method columns are aggregated from NCSBE voting_method_desc values.

certifiedResults.title: North Carolina official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are parsed from the North Carolina State Board of Elections static ENR result files for the 2024 General Election. The parser reads each county result file and validates candidate sums against the statewide result file.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Official result dashboard HTML points to static files under enr/20241105/data/; archive contains county.txt, contest.txt, results_0.txt, and results_1.txt through results_100.txt.

wardDetail.title: North Carolina precinct or reporting-unit detail
wardDetail.detail: The current official ENR promotion uses county result files for the presidential contest. Precinct-level review drilldowns remain disabled until an official precinct-sort source is mapped.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: NCSBE dashboard note points precinct-sort users to Historical Election Results Data; that source is not yet mapped for review charts.

turnout.title: North Carolina official precinct/VTD turnout
turnout.detail: Precinct/VTD turnout rows are loaded by joining official NCSBE history_stats turnout rows to official voter_stats registration denominator rows by county, precinct, and VTD. Vote-method columns are aggregated from NCSBE history voting_method_desc values.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: NCSBE 2024 General Election Turnout page cites history_stats_20241105.zip as the overall turnout source; official S3 public files also provide voter_stats_20241105.zip for denominators.
